title: PackageManifest
description: One manifest format for every package kind (skill, app, companion, integration, model, wakeword, voice, theme, module). See platform plan 5.1 and .github's docs/PACKAGES.md.

id.description: Unique in the catalog. No third-party name in it.

examples.description: Five or more, required at bronze (docs/PACKAGES.md).

args.description: A JSON Schema for this package's call arguments.

requires.description: Capabilities from the capability vocabulary (spec/vocab/capabilities.json) this package cannot run without.

optional.description: Capabilities that add behavior but are not required.

min_role.description: The floor role a person needs to invoke this package.

consequential.description: Raises the routing bar (4.5): a consequential skill needs more confidence before it fires.

offline.description: Stated offline behavior, required at bronze.

data_sources.description: Feeds the generated privacy row (docs/ENGINEERING.md > Privacy).

notifications.description: Notification ids this package declares, per docs/NOTIFICATIONS.md.

cache.description: key_template, ttl_s, stale_ok_s, max_bytes, max_age_s, scope, platform overrides (4.10).

contributes.description: Shell blueprints (6.1): nav entries, pages, right-pane panels, settings sections, commands, quick actions, player hooks, admin sections.

pages.description: Ids of UI schema page documents this package ships (6.2).

setup.description: A declared setup flow, the one escape hatch beyond a plain settings form (docs/SETTINGS.md rule 1).

provides.description: For integrations: what this package makes available to others (5.4).

min_app.description: Minimum hub/robot version this package needs.

kit_version.description: The @maipai/ui ui-v tag this package's UI was built against, if it ships one.

reply.description: Default reply shape hints for the router, if any.

timeout_ms.description: Bounds handle(). Defaults per 4.9: 4000 on the robot, 8000 on the hub.

tier.description: 0: declarative (a recipe or prompt body). 1: Deno code.

smoke.description: The smoke test entry, run at install, update, and on a schedule.

source.description: For a package that graduated to its own repo (5.1).
